# LyricTap

LyricTap is an iPhone and iPad lyric sync app with free manual syncing and AI Auto-Sync.

## Core capabilities

- Create and edit synchronized lyric timelines.
- Export LRC, SRT, and TXT lyric files.
- Create portrait or landscape lyric videos with three visual templates.
- Sync English, Japanese, and Chinese songs.
- Import supported audio files, including audio exported from Suno or Udio. LyricTap is not officially integrated with or affiliated with either service.
- Use the free browser manual-sync studio locally without uploading audio or creating an account.

## Official links

- Website: https://569001773-wq.github.io/lyrictap-support/
